title: The National Food Security Act, 2013
verified_how: Fetched a Wayback copy (6 Feb 2026) of the India Code PDF. It shows 'THE NATIONAL FOOD SECURITY ACT, 2013' and 'ACT NO. 20 OF 2013', a current consolidated text hosted on India Code. No repeal was found.
notes: Legal entitlement to subsidised foodgrains through the targeted PDS. Distribution is implemented by the States.
